question: What appearance and disruptive power are attributed to the golden-hued form?
premises: The form has the splendor of molten gold
It is a cause of agitation of cities and the like
Appearance and effect are linked to the same form
inference: The molten-gold form is associated with causing agitation of cities and similar effects
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is a cause of the agitation of cities and the like.
